canon: Planeadora grande de alas rígidas que cabalga los frentes de viento. Vuela alto y en círculos con buen tiempo; cuando cruza baja y en línea recta, los pastores saben que viene tormenta de arena magnética. Anida en lo alto de los Pilares Rotos. Cazarla es dificilísimo salvo en nido o con trampa cebada.

prompt.sujeto: A huge, heavy-bodied bird of prey in full flight, with a thick, deep chest, a short body and two very long, broad wings raised and swept up and outward.
prompt.proporcion: The wingspan is about three and a half times the length of its torso, each wing is one and a half times as wide as the body is deep, and the head is two thirds as long as the torso.
prompt.cuerpo: The belly and thighs are dark umber-brown, covered in small, overlapping, leathery scales. The long flight feathers of both wings are glossy black, the lower ones edged in deep red.
rasgos: The head and shoulders are armoured with thick, ridged, jagged plates of dull bone-grey and pale cream that grow out of the dark skin, and a crown of long, sharp, backswept bone-grey spikes rises from the back of the head.
The beak is long, pale grey and deeply hooked, and a small amber eye glints under a heavy bony brow.
prompt.rasgosSecundarios: The thick, scaly legs hang forward below the belly, ending in long, black, curved talons.
prompt.pose: Seen in three-quarter view, the body is tilted in a shallow dive with the wings raised in a V and the head angled downward, turned slightly toward the viewer, the whole bird visible from wing tip to wing tip.
prompt.entorno: Below it a vast red-brown dust storm sweeps across the plain and rolls up the left side of the frame with flying grit, and tall, jagged, pale-brown rock pillars crowd the right horizon.
prompt.luz: The low sun breaks through a heavy bank of dark storm clouds at the upper right, sending golden rays across a copper-orange sky and lighting the bone plates and the feather edges with warm light.

rasgos+: This male has a taller crown of spikes and heavier plates over the shoulders.
This female is slightly larger in the wings, with a lower crown of spikes and smaller plates over the shoulders.

momento:noche.luz: Deep blue night with stars showing through gaps in a heavy bank of dark storm clouds at the upper right under a soft, even pearly glow, and a cool silver-blue light picks out the bone plates and the red feather edges.
